summary: No holding had a thesis-breaking headline or filing today. Equity was $598.89 (-0.19%) against SPY +0.86%, and the move came from price action rather than news. DPZ (-1.6%), CARG (-1.5%) and IDXX (-0.8%) fell with no company-specific negative story in the input (DPZ only had a Minecraft collaboration; IDXX had a Jefferies PT cut from $795 to $705 on 10-20, which was already out when it was bought). Today's buys have no 8-K red flags (no 4.01, 4.02, 5.02 or large 1.01/2.01 items on any holding). The FAST concern about an unverified earnings date is resolved: it filed an 8-K 2.02 on 10-14 and a 10-Q on 10-19, so the quarter is already reported and the next estimate is 2027-01-19. BTC news was supportive (ETF inflows, JPM bullish projection, SpaceX holding BTC) and shows no exchange failure or adverse regulation, so its invalidation news trigger has not fired. The CFTC proposal to allow up to 7x retail crypto leverage is a mild two-sided risk and not a break.
upcoming: CARG: estimated earnings 2026-11-05 (15 days out, approximate, no filings in the last 7 days to confirm), the only new position with an unreported quarter. Its invalidation clause about an adverse earnings date has not triggered. IDXX: estimated 11-02 (12 days), outside the 5-day window, with Jefferies' PT cut as a sentiment negative to watch. WMT: ~11-19 (29 days). DPZ: next estimate shows 2027-02-22 but its Q3 was reported 10-13, so that date is plausible. Market-level event risk for VOO/VTI/BTC: mega-cap earnings this week (META, TSLA, AMZN), the AI/data-center wobble (Fink recession warning, SOX fragility, midterm polling), $110 Brent and Iran talks (both BTC and energy ride on this), a Moody's France rating update on 10-23, and rate-hike odds under Fed Chair Warsh. Not held but relevant to the shadow book: VRSN reports ~10-22 and SAM ~10-22 (both approximate), MCO and WDFC were due today. The news-analyst scorecard still shows 16 pending calls and none graded, so there is no track record to adjust against yet. Lesson L1 (anchor stops to the fill) does not apply to my role.
